title: Workbench (the mower's garage)
description: An open-air workbench: a sturdy wooden bench with a lower shelf, a vice, a hammer and a can on top, a red toolbox on the shelf, a yellow oil drum at one end, and a pegboard of hanging tools with a red sign plank on two posts behind it. Front faces +Z.
